EGF.coordJac Φ i s = ENNReal.ofReal |(fderiv ℝ (Φ i).symm s).det|. That is the absolute determinant of the derivative of Φ_i^{-1} at s. It is exactly |det J_s Φ_i^{-1}| with J_s 'the Jacobian matrix at s' (l.240, unchanged and now consistent).

EGF.backwardWeight Φ α fout J i s is inflowTerm_i(s) / Σ_j inflowTerm_j(s), with inflowTerm_i(s) = α^i(Φ_i^{-1}s) · f_out(Φ_i^{-1}s) · J_i(s). With J = coordJac this is l.237's quotient, term for term.

EGF.backward_policy_diffeomorph covers C^n diffeomorphisms (n ≥ 1) of a finite-dimensional real space with a Haar measure, an IsEGFPolicy and F_out = f_out μ. EGF.backward_policy_addHaar covers measurable bijections with differentiable inverse. Both prove that the kernel with these weights is the backward star policy, Markov and unique F_in-a.e. They also prove F_in = f_in μ, where f_in is the denominator. The body's setting at l.234 (S = R^d, Lebesgue, parametrizable diffeomorphisms) is an instance.

answers.l295_theorem_3_4: The density is right at l.295. Theorem 3.4 is about the set of outflow densities: 'the set of $\foutstar$ such that $(\ForwardPolicyStar,\foutstar)$ is in the family is dense in the non-negative cone of $L^2(\Statespace,\lambda)$' has to be a set of functions to be dense in L². Its Lean reading is EGF.universality_of_ergodic_family (and EGF.universality): D : Set (S → ℝ) with hD : ∀ f ∈ D, ∃ F ∈ 𝓕, F.policy = π ∧ F.outflow = λ.withDensity f⁺, and hdense : IsDenseNonnegConeL2 λ D. So '(π*, f_out*) is in the family' abbreviates the flow (π*, f_out* λ), and the density is the object of the hypothesis. Writing F_out* there would make 'dense in L²' a statement about measures. This is the same shorthand as Theorem B.1 (l.830, EGF.IsUniversalPolicy: ∃ bounded f_out ≥ 0 in L², the flow (π, f_out λ)), which C-43 rightly leaves. It is also C-20's applied wording, which is not in C-43's `printed`. An optional clarification for a later C-20 round would be '$(\ForwardPolicyStar,\foutstar\lambda)$'. Nothing to do here.
answers.l375_and_l404: Two different lines share the number 375. v2 l.375 is the commented-out corollary (v1 l.347). It begins with '%', never prints, and needs nothing. C-43's 'l.375 (Corollary 3.10)' is a v1 line, which in v2 is l.404, printed and still '(\ForwardPolicyStar, \foutstar)'. The entry leaves it deliberately, and that is right. The corollary's δ := ∫ δf_init dλ needs F_out* ≪ λ: EGF.pinsker_negative_control_density has the hypothesis hout : F.outflow ≪ λ, and pinsker_negative_control_isEGF has F.outflow = λ.withDensity f_out. So the density in the pair carries a hypothesis the statement uses. It is not a typo of the l.341/l.888 kind.
